format_note: Original format (questions only) caused agent to stop in run-02. Adjusted format adds 'Now continue fixing the code.' directive.

run-02.note: HARMFUL: original checkpoint format caused agent to stop after analysis

run-04.note: Adjusted format. Agent continued but took more steps than baseline

run-06.note: STRONGEST signal: fewer errors, fewer test runs, no same-path retry vs baseline

task_a.note: Original checkpoint format caused agent to stop. Task not completed.

task_b.note: Adjusted format prevented stop but guarded run took more steps.

task_c.note: Guarded run outperformed baseline on all metrics.

key_findings: FINDING_1_FORMAT_CRITICAL: The original checkpoint format (questions only) caused the agent to stop working entirely (run-02). The adjusted format (adding 'Now continue fixing the code.') prevented this harmful behavior in runs 04 and 06.

FINDING_2_MIXED_HELPFULNESS: With the adjusted format, the checkpoint showed mixed results: neutral in run-04 (more steps than baseline) and helpful in run-06 (fewer steps, fewer errors, no same-path retry).

FINDING_3_AGENT_DEPENDENT: The policy's effect depends heavily on the agent model. Sophisticated agents (GitHub Copilot) adapt after 1 error and never trigger the policy. Weaker agents are more likely to benefit but also more likely to be harmed by poorly formatted interventions.
FINDING_4_SMALL_SAMPLE: 6 runs with 3 matched pairs is insufficient for statistical conclusions. The helpful signal from Task C could be noise.
FINDING_5_NO_METABOLIZATION: This pilot does not metabolize the policy. It provides real-agent evidence that must be combined with the existing replay and simulated pilot evidence.
status_reasoning: The pilot produced one harmful intervention (original format), one neutral (adjusted format), and one helpful (adjusted format). The format adjustment is a critical finding that changes the intervention's risk profile. More runs with the adjusted format are needed to determine whether the helpful signal from Task C is consistent.
operator_notes: Pilot run with real VS Code agents under operator supervision.
Original checkpoint format caused agent to stop (run-02).
